invariants_acknowledged: Every event-type and public-booking query and write carries an explicit tenantId; RLS is not the tenant boundary (tenant-context.ts:131-135).
Public booking resolves the tenant only from Tenant.bookingHandle via one lookup query; tenantId/hostId/leadId are never accepted from the request body (strict schemas).
Unknown handle, unknown slug, inactive type, firm without saved availability and unavailable host all return an identical NOT_FOUND after the same single DB call.

A booking re-checks the slot inside one transaction under a per-tenant pg_advisory_xact_lock with transaction-local app.current_tenant_id; two concurrent books of one slot yield one success and one CONFLICT.
Booking leads are always AI-scored (owner Q8/Q9); there is no AI toggle; LeadCreated lands in the outbox in the same transaction via LeadService.createLeadInTransaction.
Existing leads and contacts are never linked or modified from anonymous input (owner Q11); only the host email flags a match.

All destructive event-type writes run in $transaction; no skipDuplicates; colorToken is CHECK-constrained to the 18-token TAG palette; duplicate booking slugs rejected by Zod superRefine and the DB unique.
All five migrations are additive Class A, applied only to the local test DB in this task; production apply is manual and must precede the API ship (L13).
Emails use fixed templates with every interpolated value HTML-escaped and CR/LF stripped from subjects; tests use the mock notification adapter and never send real mail.
